rooms.name: Steam steering and emergency tiller
rooms.inventory: Steam steering engines, connected worm shaft/quadrant, rudder stock/pintles and emergency hand tiller.

rooms.name: Triple-expansion engine room
rooms.inventory: Cast bedplate, bearing blocks, three graduated cylinders, A-frame standards, crosshead guides, three-throw crankshaft, piston/conrods, separate eccentric/valve links, control gauges, connected receivers and working platforms.

rooms.name: After stokehold
rooms.inventory: Three single-ended Scotch boilers, four dished furnace doors each, ashdoors, gauges, water columns, stay bolts, saddles, safety valves, connected steam/feed/flue branches, coal shutters and fire tools.

rooms.name: Middle stokehold
rooms.inventory: Three single-ended Scotch boilers with full furnace fittings, connected steam/feed/flue branches and a clear stoke aisle.

rooms.name: Forward stokehold
rooms.inventory: Three single-ended Scotch boilers, connected forward-funnel uptake, feed/steam headers and furnace fittings.

rooms.name: Dynamos and electrical workshop
rooms.inventory: Two period dynamo housings, copper windings/commutators, slate switchboards, analog instruments, knife switches and workshop bench/vice.

rooms.name: Feed and circulating pump flat
rooms.inventory: Reciprocating feed pumps, hotwell and sea circulation/feed/condensate connections.

rooms.name: Watertight shaft alley
rooms.inventory: Aligned shaft segments/couplings, thrust collars/bearings, stern tube, guard rails, lamps, service-steam main and elevated accommodation-side access.
